pressuring.label: 10-year REAL yield
pressuring.why: Precious metals pay no income, so the real yield IS the cost of holding them. At 2.41% real (10Y 4.63% minus 2.22% breakeven inflation) that cost is high.

pressuring.label: Gold price trend
pressuring.why: Price is down its moving averages with RSI 62.0. Trend confirms a move, it does not cause one.

neutral.label: US dollar (DXY)
